name: NYC DOB permit issuance (legacy BIS)
publisher: NYC Department of Buildings (NYC Open Data)
filters_example: job_type = 'NB'  (new building; also 'DM' demolition, 'A1' major alteration)

traps.check: issuance_date is stored as text (MM/DD/YYYY), so date filters on the portal compare strings, not dates. ProveIt parses dates after download.
One job has many permits. Count job__ if you mean projects.
A permit is permission, not completion.
Coordinates are geocoded to the street frontage, so many points sit just outside their lot. Match lots with polygon_match = nearest (about 30 m), or by BBL.
